name: Alex's Hope & Alex's Solitude
source:
A prologue to the upcoming visual novel "Alex's Journey to the Grave", this kinetic novel tells two stories from the pasts of the main characters.

[b]Alex's Hope[/b]
The emotionally difficult story of a boy with a critical lack of love regaining his hope. With dark themes including depression, self harm, and suicidal thoughts, it may not be for everyone, but it is an intense emotional experience.

[b]Alex's Solitude[/b]
The story of a stubbornly good-hearted girl clashing with those around her. Cliques, highschool drama, and bullying will come together to affect her school days irreversibly.

[From [url=https://violethorizons.itch.io/alexs-hope-alexs-solitude]itch.io[/url]]
